description: Solar Panels is a dataset listed in UK national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Calderdale Metropolitan Borough Council. Dashboards showing how much electricity the Council is generating from nine of its buildings which have been fitted with solar photovoltaic panels installed as part of the Re:fit programme. The dashboards shows energy generated each day/month by kilowatt-hour (kWh) compared to estimated generation for this year. Coverage: Calderdale Metropolitan Borough Council. The portal files it under the publisher Calderdale Metropolitan Borough Council. The portal shows 2026-09-25 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-uk-portal.
